title: AUGUSTUS: An LLM-Driven Multimodal Agent System with Contextualized User Memory

layout.note: Two horizontal lanes mirrored about the middle: the blue AUGUSTUS loop on top, the orange HUMAN loop below. Each lane is a stage-bar frame (Encode, Store in Memory, Retrieve on the outer edge, Act on the inner edge, closed by a rectangular loop arrow) around three columns split by dashed lines: a 2x2 input grid, a memory frame with a limited-size box over a dashed region of two cylinders, and a two-cell retrieval column. A staggered row of function-call chips sits between the two Act bars.

lesson: State an analogy by redrawing the human counterpart as a mirror-image lane that reuses the method's own layout, so each part is compared with its counterpart by position and colour alone; close a cycle with stage bars as a frame and one rectangular loop arrow.
